name: Transaction Management & Unit of Work
description: Transaction Management & Unit of Work standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-BE-TX applies.

rules.title: Place the transaction boundary in the application use case
rules.detail: The use case that owns the business invariant starts/commits the unit of work; controllers and repositories do not independently create unrelated nested transactions.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Place the transaction boundary in the application use case.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Place the transaction boundary in the application use case.

rules.title: Keep transactions short
rules.detail: Perform validation/read/write needed for atomicity, but avoid user interaction, remote HTTP calls and long computation while locks are held.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Keep transactions short.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Keep transactions short.

rules.title: Rollback the whole invariant on failure
rules.detail: Exceptions before commit leave no partial durable state for changes that are required to succeed together.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Rollback the whole invariant on failure.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Rollback the whole invariant on failure.

rules.title: Coordinate external side effects with outbox or post-commit processing
rules.detail: Database commit plus message/email/webhook cannot rely on unsafe dual writes for critical consistency.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Coordinate external side effects with outbox or post-commit processing.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Coordinate external side effects with outbox or post-commit processing.

rules.title: Define concurrency behavior at transaction boundaries
rules.detail: Use suitable isolation, version checks, constraints or locks for known races and map conflicts to deterministic application outcomes.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define concurrency behavior at transaction boundaries.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define concurrency behavior at transaction boundaries.

rules.title: Test rollback and retry behavior
rules.detail: Integration tests cover mid-transaction failure and, for critical operations, concurrency/deadlock retry without duplicated side effects.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test rollback and retry behavior.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test rollback and retry behavior.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-BE-TX applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Transaction Management & Unit of Work to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Transaction Management & Unit of Work is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Transaction Management & Unit of Work failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
